## Requirements (from the contract)
- R1 Export-mode build in deploy: `web/dist` built with `SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export` + `SIG_EXPORT_DIR` at the P27.4
  national export — FAILS LOUD if the export is absent (never a fixtures fall-back for the public build).
- R2 Publish only the published compartment: the GCS sync pushes `web/dist` + `exports/out/public` to the public
  buckets and keeps `exports/out/restricted` private — a test PROVES no restricted/ODbL/UNDETERMINED byte reaches a public object (§42).
- R3 Hosted verification: probe the live `sig-web` + public export manifest (`sig-ops probe-hosted`), confirm the
  real national data renders (not the demo), record the built-from spine/export watermark. Canonical origin
  `https://surveillancegraph.org` (DNS/TLS cut-over is P27.10; `*.run.app` stays the documented fallback).
- R4 Gate package: assemble the HG-01/HG-11/HG-02 publication checklist for the record.
- R5 Records: `docs/build/runs/P27.8.md`, PR body, `PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST` update; RETURN PASS row for the gated public cut-over.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC1 the deploy build produces a real-data `web/dist` (`SIG_DATA_SOURCE=export`), failing loud without the export *(deterministic)*
- AC2 the sync publishes only `web/dist` + the published compartment; a test proves no restricted/ODbL/UNDETERMINED object is public *(deterministic)*
- AC3 a hosted deploy renders the real national data; `probe-hosted` green; the built-from watermark recorded *(live-gated)*
- AC4 the HG-01/HG-11/HG-02 publication package is assembled; public cut-over staged and gated (RETURN PASS until ticked) *(agentic)*
- AC5 `make check` + `tests/ops` + build-memory green; no merge/tag/push-main *(deterministic)*

## Plan
Live-vs-deferred decision (recorded first): ADC IS present in the run shell (account `14stevevitali@gmail.com`,
project `zeta-medley-508121-u7` reachable) — BUT the national export `exports/out/national` does **not** exist and
**cannot be validly built yet**: D-P27.4-1 (national export) is OPEN and chains to D-SOURCES.17-1 (the ~1.37M OSM
land is *LAND IN PROGRESS*, execution RUNNING). Building/publishing a national surface now would either fail loud
(nothing to publish — correct) or fall back to a demo (forbidden) or freeze a mid-flight PROVISIONAL total (forbidden
by D-P27.1-1). So the live national cut-over is genuinely blocked on the national-export prerequisite, not merely on
ADC → do EVERYTHING deterministic + record the hosted cut-over as an honest deferral (D-P27.8-1) + RETURN PASS. No
fabricated live green, no fabricated deployed URL.

1. **Export-mode public build (R1/AC1).** New `ops/src/ops/publish.py`: `public_export_dir()` (`SIG_EXPORT_DIR` else
   `exports/out/national` — the P27.4 national export, never the okc demo); `assert_export_present()` (fails loud —
   `PublishError` — if the export dir / a required `web/*.json` / `manifest.json` is absent; NEVER a fixtures
   fall-back); `build_public_web()` (assert → `degraded.build_static_site(data_source="export", export_dir=…)` →
   `web/dist`, loud on failure).
2. **Compartment partition + leak guard (R2/AC2).** In `publish.py`: `classify_compartment()` fail-closed —
   **public iff its licence is non-`share_alike` and not export-excluded; else restricted** (data-driven off
   `policy.licensing`: ODbL-1.0 + CC-BY-SA-4.0 are `share_alike=true` → restricted; UNDETERMINED never reaches a
   compartment and is rejected if present). `partition_export(export_root, public_root, restricted_root)` reads the
   manifest, copies each artifact + the `web/` subtree + root descriptors into `exports/out/public` (published) or
   `exports/out/restricted` (private), writes a filtered public manifest, returns counts + the watermark.
   `assert_public_clean(public_root)` re-scans the public tree/manifest and raises `CompartmentLeak` (loud) naming
   any ODbL/share-alike/UNDETERMINED/excluded artifact — the deliverable-2 proof.
3. **Deploy wiring (R1/R2).** `deploy.build_gcp_plan` gains ordered steps: export-mode build → partition →
   assert-public-clean → the three syncs (unchanged). `cli._cmd_deploy` performs build+partition+clean-check in
   apply mode (ADC present, not `--dry-run`) before the syncs; dry-run prints the plan (forced without ADC).
4. **Hosted verification wiring (R3/AC3).** `publish.export_watermark()` reads `manifest.reproducibility_inputs`
   (release_id/content_key/as_of/ruleset/resolver) — the built-from watermark. `ops/cadence.toml` gains a
   `sig-public-national-manifest` probe target (`…-sig-public/manifest.json`) so `probe-hosted` covers the national
   public export manifest; canonical origin `https://surveillancegraph.org` documented (probed via
   `SIG_PROBE_WEB_URL` at cut-over; DNS/TLS is P27.10, may not resolve yet). Live probe DEFERRED (D-P27.8-1).
5. **Gate package (R4/AC4).** `PUBLICATION_CHECKLIST.md` national section assembling HG-01/HG-11/HG-02 carry-forward
   answers + the licence-compartment posture + Part VIII safeguards; go-public staged, operator tick pending.
6. **Records (R5).** ADR-096 (national published-compartment posture: only non-share-alike public; ODbL/share-alike
   national layer stays private, a conservative tightening reconciled with §42.3); D-P27.8-1 deferral + RETURN PASS
   row; this run ledger + PR body; ledger/BUILD_INDEX advance.
